page.layout: One page, a title page. Top: the main title in large capitals, with a smaller line above and below. Middle: a short block of smaller lines and a name. Lower middle: a printer's device (engraving). Bottom: the imprint in small type.
page.notes: The scan is faint and the small lines of the title are hard to read. The lines marked illegible are visible but could not be read letter by letter. The central block is set in a smaller black-letter-like type and is not clear enough to copy. The engraving below the title is a printer's device, not text, and is not transcribed. The imprint at the foot is in very small type and is largely illegible. The main title "ARCANORVM ARMINIANISMI PARS SECVNDA." is read with some confidence.
